`functools.lru_cache` leaves `maxsize` at its default of 128 when applied directly as `@lru_cache`. Passing `maxsize=None` makes the cache unbounded instead.

`functools.wraps` calls `update_wrapper`, whose default `WRAPPER_ASSIGNMENTS` copies `__module__`, `__name__`, `__qualname__`, `__annotations__`, `__type_params__` and `__doc__` onto the wrapper. So `__name__` is preserved.
